# 格局編輯器 Floorplan Editor

> A free, browser-only floorplan editor. Type each room's width and height,
> drag rooms into your home's layout, mark windows and doors with compass
> bearings, then export as human-readable text, JSON, or PNG. All data stays
> in the user's browser (localStorage) — nothing is uploaded. UI is in
> Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant). Dimensions are stored in centimeters; the
> display can be switched between metric (cm) and imperial (feet/inches).

Live app: https://g-brodiei.github.io/floorplan-universe/
Source (MIT): https://github.com/g-brodiei/floorplan-universe

## What it does

- Drag-and-drop rectangular rooms with wall-thickness-aware snapping
  (share-a-wall vs. fully-adjacent positions)
- Free rotation with 15° snapping; labels stay upright
- Windows and doors placed on walls, with automatic compass bearing
  calculation (set which compass direction is "up" on screen)
- Export: plain-text summary (designed to be pasted to contractors,
  designers, or AI assistants), structured JSON, or PNG image
- AI import: a built-in prompt lets users describe their home in natural
  language to any AI, then paste the AI's JSON reply back to import it
- Trace mode: load a photo of an existing floorplan as an underlay
- Autosave to localStorage; undo/redo; first-run guided tour

## Data format (for AI assistants generating floorplans)

JSON with `version`, `name`, `unit` ("cm"), `upBearing` (0=N, 90=E, 180=S,
270=W), `wallThickness`, `rooms[]` (name, w, h, x, y, rot, fill,
openings[]), and `extras[]`. Openings have `type` (window|door), `wall`
(N|E|S|W in the room's own frame), `offset`, `length`, `note`. All lengths
in integer centimeters. Coordinates: x grows right, y grows down; a room's
x,y is its top-left corner. The full prompt template lives at:
https://github.com/g-brodiei/floorplan-universe/blob/main/examples/ai-prompt.md

## Notes

- Static site, no backend, no accounts, no tracking.
- Works offline once loaded; can also run from file:// or as a bundled
  single HTML file.
